axes: x right, y down on the plan crop (raster frame, 2.25 px/cm); origin = the crop's top-left; angles are bearings, 0 = up (-y), clockwise

plan_meta.tracer: main session, trace-rooms.mjs (raster: grey fill = walls, double strokes = glazing, wall-connected single strokes = door leaves; zone bars from the config)
plan_meta.trace_method: flood fill from each camera inside a barrier mask built from the drawing; wall footprints from the grey fill (opened, 37 pieces); openings from region contacts and wall-end gaps; panes from double strokes split by adjacency
plan_meta.scale_basis: fitted from the printed room dimensions: 6 rooms, median ratio 0.9946 over the nominal 3.292 px/cm -> 3.2741 px/cm
plan_meta.rights_note: uploaded by the developer through the Habait Studio portal
plan_meta.floor_height_note: unknown: the sales plan has no section
assumptions: ceiling 290 cm, door heads 215 cm (no section on the sales plan)
outdoor rooms unroofed unless the plan shows a floor-above line (follow the sales plan)
open-plan zone boundaries: auto-trace geodesic split between the printed room labels
plan_meta.rooms_method: auto_rooms.py: orthogonal (axis 17.5 deg), printed rectangles snapped to the walls, leftover joined
